field.label: License Key
field.comment:
Please insert the license key and then click on the "Validate License Key" button.
After making the purchase, you should receive a license key via email. Contact us at help@rootways.com if you didn't receive it.

field.label: Is Multi Store
field.comment: If your website has multiple stores with different URLs then set this option to Yes and contact us at help@rootways.com for register multi-store license key.

group.label: Payment Module for Authorize.net (by Rootways Inc.)
group.comment:
Accept credit cards and Google Pay in your Magento store.
No setup or monthly fees and your customers never leave your store to complete the purchase.

group.label: Basic Authorize.net Settings.
group.comment:
If your Authorize.net account is a sandbox, click here for API details. And if your account is in production, click here to get API details.
For any queries and questions, reach out to us at help@rootways.com

field.label: Debug
field.comment: rw_authorize_payment.log file will be generated under /var/log/

group.label: Authorize.net CIM (Customer Information Manager) Settings.
group.comment:
In this payment method, we have two types of payment forms "Hosted iFrame: (AcceptUI.js) and On-site payment (with/without Accept.js). You can use anything you want as per your business model.
Read more about Rootways Authorize.net extension on our website www.rootways.com

field.label: Payment Form Type
field.comment:
On-site: Here we use the Magento payment form, and the user enters the credit card details on your website. This payment form has a feature to encrypt plain credit card details using Authorize.net Accept.js
Hosted iFrame Popup: Here we use Authorize.net hosted form, and the user enters the credit card details on the Authorize.net server. Click here to know how the iFrame Pop Up looks on the checkout page.

field.label: Enable Accept.js (SAQ A-EP Level PCI Compliance)
field.comment: Accept.js is a JavaScript library for sending secure payment data directly to Authorize.Net. so, it is very secure and recommended to set Yes.

field.label: Hosted Popup Button Text
field.comment: Click here to know more.

field.label: Hosted Popup Header Text
field.comment: Click here to know more.

field.label: Vault Enabled (Save Credit Card)
field.comment:
This option gives the facility to save credit card tokens for future use. So when any user comes to your website a second time, they can generate an order without entering credit card details again.
Click here to know more.

field.label: Always Save Credit Card
field.comment: Hide save credit card option from checkout and always save the credit card token to the Magento Vault.

field.label: Validation Mode
field.comment:
Choose whether to validate a credit card when updating it from the My Account Page.
liveMode: $0 or $0.01 (depending on card type and processor) live transaction is processed against the card and then immediately voided.
testMode: Card data is validated using simple mathematical checks to confirm that it appears to be valid. It is not a guarantee that the card is legitimate and customer data is not validated.

field.label: Payment Action
field.comment:
Authorize Only: Payment authorizes only at the time of generating order and payment is captured while generating an invoice from admin order.
Authorize and Capture: Payment will be authorized and captured only when the order is generated.
Order: Use when you want to neither authorize nor capture but want to generate the credit card token along with $0 authorization. The actual transactions will be added to the payment gateway when generating the invoice from the Magento admin.

field.label: Credit Card Types
field.comment: Select credit card type which allows for capturing payment at the checkout page.

field.label: Credit Card Logo Location
field.comment: Choose the location where you want to display the logo of the credit cards. Click here to view more.

field.label: Message in Checkout Page
field.comment: Enter the message which you want to display on the checkout page. Leave it blank if you do not want to add any message. Click here to view more.

field.label: Transfer Billing Address Details
field.comment: If set to yes, then billing address will be sent with each transaction and billing details will be visible under Authorize.net transaction in your Authorize.net account.

field.label: Transfer Shipping Address Details
field.comment: If set to yes, then shipping address will be sent with each transaction and shipping details will be visible under Authorize.net transaction in your Authorize.net account.

field.label: Enable Google reCAPTCHA
field.comment: If set to Yes, it will enable Google reCAPTCHA on the payment method page on the front-end checkout page. It helps in preventing carding and bot transaction related issues.

field.label: Google reCAPTCHA v2 Site Key
field.comment: Click here to generate Google reCAPTCHA Key https://www.google.com/recaptcha/admin/create

field.label: Google reCAPTCHA v3 Site Key
field.comment: Click here to generate Google reCAPTCHA Key https://www.google.com/recaptcha/admin/create

field.label: Minimum Score Threshold
field.comment:
Default Value: 0.5
From 0.0 to 1.0, where 1.0 is very likely a good interaction, and 0.0 is very likely a bot. For more details, see the official documentation Interpreting the score.

field.label: reCAPTCHA v2 Validation Failure Message.
field.comment: Default Message; reCAPTCHA verification failed.

field.label: reCAPTCHA v3 Validation Failure Message.
field.comment: Default Message; You cannot proceed with such operation, your reCAPTCHA reputation is too low.

field.label: Include Google reCAPTCHA JS on Checkout page
field.comment: If the theme or any other extension on your website already including Google reCAPTCHA JavaScript on the checkout page of your website then set this option to "No", otherwise set it to "YES" to include Google reCAPTCHA JS. Here is the link to Google reCAPTCHA JS https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api.js. It should be included once only on checkout page.
